algorithm: Decode UTF-8; split only at LF; take each inclusive 1-based physical-line range; strip outer whitespace from each selected range; join ranges with one LF; split paragraphs at a blank line (regex newline-whitespace-newline); replace each whitespace run within a paragraph by one space; join nonempty paragraphs by two LF and append one LF. No lexical, punctuation, numbering or date correction.
excluded: Surrounding non-act text, running page heads/numbers and Google digitizer furniture. Supremi retains its terminal historical editorial note.
